title: burn.yaml
description: Roles defined in code. `burn apply` sends each role to PUT /roles/{name} with managed_by code; the dashboard shows these roles read-only. `burn pull` writes dashboard-made roles out in this format.

owner.description: Team or person responsible for this role's instances.

tools.description: MCP tools the role's instances may call (names from contracts/mcp-tools.json). Enforced by the Gateway.

credentials.description: Own credentials minted for each instance.

may_message.description: Roles this role's instances may send_message to.

may_spawn.description: Roles this role's instances may start as children. A child never gets more tools, credentials or egress than its parent.

egress.description: Outbound hosts this role may reach through the proxy. Omit for the default allowlist. Burn's own Gateway is never blocked by it, since the Gateway already checks tools per role; every other destination, model endpoints included, must be listed.

canaries.description: Give each instance its own canary (a decoy key that never authenticates).

auto_burn.description: Burn an instance automatically when its canary is used from outside Burn. false = report-only: alert and flag, never burn.

references.description: Credentials Burn recognizes in tool output: replace = the agent gets {{burn:ref:<secret_ref>}} instead of the value; report = record what would be replaced, change nothing; off = neither. Canaries are never replaced.

replace_on_burn.description: Start a clean replacement when one of this role's instances is burned (not when the whole role is burned).
